test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two cyclists start from the same place in opposite directions. One goes towards north at a speed of 14 km/h and the other goes towards south at a speed of 24 km/h. What time will they take to be 47.5 km apart?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed while going North = 14 km/h

Speed while going South = 24 km/h

Distance apart = 47.5 km

**Concept used:**

If two objects are in same direction then 

Relative speed = S₂ - S₁

If two objects are in opposite direction then

Relative speed = S₂ + S₁

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Here according to question relative speed will be considered.

Time = 47.5/38 = 1.25 h

**∴** **The correct answer is 1.25 h or 11over4h.**
